parts.text: Des to Revex (independent review), Orc informed: Marquee extraction for issue #1 is ready for review in draft PR #5 to dev, at 6e3fa9f3fe8f316d5b63b523ada8c03fe6d68fb3 (the PR HEAD adds only this message). Bases: dev 3dfd232, standard c2ca848, frontend e492bec read only and unchanged, method copied locally from Folio 0856c72 (from Console 018fe32) with provenance; no dependency on either. Identity confirmed against the source: shelves of three tiles, covers/initials, bounded 21:9 banner, chips, form card, large Manrope 800 headings with DM Sans UI, shadows in both modes, hover lift reset under reduced motion. Configuration: values as written, omitted roles keep defaults (action-pressed follows effective hover), link independent of action, focus independent of ink, shadows configurable, F-R1 font contract and asset fallbacks kept, accent has no visible effect (documented). Executed checks: build, type check, npm test (closure, artwork, schema 5+5 cases, 48 contrast pairs, 37 Playwright tests) locally at 3cb527b and in Docker (node:24, clone at exact SHA) at fae4d97 and 6e3fa9f; external consumer from an isolated clone at 3cb527b (tarball and git); Docker demo procedure executed at 6e3fa9f with targeted stop. Docker runs here needed environment-only proxy and CA settings, which the documented procedure does not include. Parity with --control: 90/96 exact in launch one, 90/96 in launch two, 90 in both; reference self-controls 0 everywhere; six stable dark-mode differences (4-29 pixels, max delta 4/255) on rounded control edges are localized in docs/PARITY.md for Orc's decision. No threshold changed, no Console or Folio exception applied. Icons excluded everywhere. Standalone HTML, maintained Docker kit and Figma remain follow-ups. No merge requested.
